Thanks — good questions. Quick answers:

1) Data handling: For short evals we can enable a "no-logs" mode on Hosted where request/response payloads are not retained beyond transient logging needed for debugging. That is acceptable for short PoCs; for regulated workloads and long-term retention controls we recommend Dedicated or Private VPC (customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit logs).

2) Residency: We have US-region hosted endpoints and can pin the evaluation project to us-west (us-only). For strict contractual residency guarantees we usually move to Dedicated or Private.

3) Rate limits & concurrency: The default trial is conservative (60 req/min). We can temporarily increase the soft quota for your eval to support the 10 concurrent sessions at ~20 req/min (that maps to ~200 req/min total). I'll ask Aditya to provision a temporary uplift for the PoC and share token limits. Maximum tokens per request: 32,000 (model-dependent), recommended 8k for lower latency.

Next steps I will take now:
- Provision trial project at https://app.redwood.com/console/projects/fnt-eval and create an API key for eval@finlytics.ai.
- Request a temporary quota uplift to ~250 req/min and 100k tokens/min for the PoC window.
- Schedule the tech sync: Wed, 24 Feb, 10:00 PT — please confirm or propose alternatives.

If Procurement needs an evaluation SOW or a short MSA, loop me in and I can fast-track it.

Best,
Marissa

Marissa — adding a few infra details for Alex's engineers.

Quoted from Marissa:
> We can temporarily increase the soft quota for the 10 concurrent sessions at ~20 req/min each.

I'll provision a temporary uplift for the project to 250 req/min and 100k tokens/min for a 2-week PoC window. A couple of practical items for your engineers:

- Max tokens per request: 32,000 (we enforce per-request and per-response caps; see the attached rate_limits_table.csv)
- Recommended concurrency config: use short-lived connections and keep-alive; we recommend batching small messages where possible to reduce token costs.
- Sample curl for the eval (replace <API_KEY>):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"Summarize this transaction...","max_tokens":800}'

- Residency: I'll pin the project to us-west and verify the processing region is enforced. For any export/data extraction requests we will follow standard redaction and customer-request retention rules.

If you need a temporary non-logging SLA for the PoC I can enable that flag on the project; however for contractual terms we'll move that to a Dedicated/Private engagement.

Happy to hop on the sync and walk through sample payloads.
